verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own pages claim transcription in 100+ languages, list a "Multi-language Mode" feature, and say it can automatically switch languages from meeting to meeting. Switching within a single meeting is only implied by that bare feature label, and nothing shows that summaries are produced in non-English languages. missing for 10: documented summary/notes support for non-English meetings, documented handling of language switching within one meeting, details of what Multi-language Mode does, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-English accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run meetings in languages other than English — transcription and summaries support many languages and handle language switching

citations.quote: Automatically switch languages from meeting to meeting with ease.
